question: How is revenue trending by month? Return exactly these columns: month, revenue.
sql:
SELECT substr(o.order_date, 1, 7) AS month, ROUND(SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price), 2) AS revenue
FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.id
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

question: Which product categories bring in the most revenue? Return exactly these columns: category, revenue.
sql:
SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price), 2) AS revenue
FROM products p JOIN order_items i ON i.product_id = p.id
JOIN orders o ON o.id = i.order_id
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY revenue DESC

question: Who are our top 10 customers by revenue? Return exactly these columns: customer, province, revenue.
sql:
SELECT c.name AS customer, c.province, ROUND(SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price), 2) AS revenue
FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.id
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.province ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 10

question: Compare revenue across provinces Return exactly these columns: province, revenue.

question: What are our 10 best-selling products? Return exactly these columns: product, units_sold, revenue.
sql:
SELECT p.name AS product, SUM(i.quantity) AS units_sold, ROUND(SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price), 2) AS revenue
FROM products p JOIN order_items i ON i.product_id = p.id
JOIN orders o ON o.id = i.order_id
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY units_sold DESC LIMIT 10

question: How many orders have each status? Return exactly these columns: status, orders.
sql:
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders
GROUP BY status ORDER BY orders DESC

question: Compare revenue by customer segment Return exactly these columns: segment, revenue.

JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.id

question: What is our average order value? Return exactly these columns: average_order_value, completed_orders.
sql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.id), 2) AS average_order_value, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS completed_orders
FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.id
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
